source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: The fixture contract validates four local probes, stable and early-access reference tracks, four pending reference observations and four retained comparison decisions.

Five tests and 17 expectations pass against the real VaultStore and Markdown property writer: no-op byte read, source-preserving property edit, stale-write conflict preservation and symlink boundary denial.
Routine source gate passes with 121 tests and 667 expectations; the differential validator, Knip and changed-file Fallow are included.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
No issues reported in the ten-file differential-fixture increment.
Quality and desktop-build matrices passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows; the differential contract ran in quality and packaged attribution ran in desktop-build.

implemented: Added fixtures/vault-differential.json with stable 1.13.7 and early-access 1.14.1 reference tracks, deterministic local expectations and explicit reference capture procedures.
Added bun run validate:differential, a schema/decision validator that requires every unobserved comparison to remain not-compared with a decision ID and non-empty decision.
Added tests/vault-differential.test.ts so the local claims execute against the real vault safety and source-preserving writer paths rather than only validating JSON shape.
Wired the differential contract into check:fast, full quality, the quality workflow and the documented Bun script playbook.
limitations: All four reference observations remain external-pending because the pinned reference application has not been run through the corresponding open/edit/conflict/symlink procedures on the supported desktop matrix.
No comparison is marked match or mismatch yet; any future discrepancy must be added to the fixture with an explicit decision before changing compatibility behavior.
